card.name: The end of interleukin before a number
card.fires_on: The final piece "in" of the word interleukin, right before a hyphen and a number such as -1, -2 or -6. Weaker hits appear partway through other rare words.

modes.label: Interleukin ending
modes.description: The "in" that completes interleukin before a hyphenated number naming a specific interleukin.

modes.label: Other split rare words
modes.description: Partway through uncommon words in general text that are split into pieces, such as anecdotally or eggnog.

card.plain: It marks the end of the word interleukin just before a number like -1 or -6.
